title: Hybridization changes from ethene to ethane
statement:
What happens to the standard label on each carbon when ethene is hydrogenated to ethane?

[_]{a}

explanations: The change accompanies loss of the C=C pi interaction and formation of new C–H bonds.
The starting molecule is an alkene, not the corresponding alkyne.

hints: Ethene carbon has three electron domains.
Ethane carbon has four electron domains.
Match the two counts to sp² and sp³.
solution: Ethene carbon has three electron domains. Ethane carbon has four electron domains. Match the two counts to sp² and sp³. The change accompanies loss of the C=C pi interaction and formation of new C–H bonds.
